# Ricker {#sec-ricker}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    N_{t+1} = N_t e^{r (1 - \frac{N_t}{K})}
$${#eq-ricker}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Ricker model trajectories showing stable, period-4, and chaotic dynamics"
#| label: fig-ricker-sim

# Function to simulate Ricker model
simulate_ricker <- function(N0, r, K, time_steps) {
  # N0: initial population size
  # r: intrinsic growth rate
  # K: carrying capacity
  # time_steps: number of time steps to simulate

  N <- numeric(time_steps + 1)
  N[1] <- N0

  for (t in 1:time_steps) {
    N[t + 1] <- N[t] * exp(r * (1 - N[t] / K))
  }

  return(N)
}

# Parameters
N0 <- 0.1 * 10  # Initial population (10% of K)
K <- 50  # Carrying capacity
time_steps <- 50
burn_in <- 1  # Discard first points to reach attractor

# Example 1: Default r (stable equilibrium)
r_default <- 0.5
traj_default <- simulate_ricker(N0, r_default, K, time_steps)

# Example 2: Higher r (period-4 cycle)
r_p4 <- 2.
traj_p4 <- simulate_ricker(N0, r_p4, K, time_steps)

# Example 3: Even higher r (chaotic dynamics)
r_chaos <- 3.
traj_chaos <- simulate_ricker(N0, r_chaos, K, time_steps)

# Create single plot
time <- 0:time_steps
plot(NA, xlim = c(burn_in, time_steps), ylim = c(0, K * 2),
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Population size (N)",
     main = "Ricker model: from stability to chaos")

# Plot trajectories with lines and points
# Default r (stable)
lines(time[-(1:(burn_in+1))], traj_default[-(1:(burn_in+1))],
      col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.6), lwd = 1.5)
points(time[-(1:(burn_in+1))], traj_default[-(1:(burn_in+1))],
       col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.6), pch = 16, cex = 0.4)

# Period-4 r
lines(time[-(1:(burn_in+1))], traj_p4[-(1:(burn_in+1))],
      col = rgb(1, 0.5, 0, 0.6), lwd = 1.5)
points(time[-(1:(burn_in+1))], traj_p4[-(1:(burn_in+1))],
       col = rgb(1, 0.5, 0, 0.6), pch = 16, cex = 0.4)

# Chaotic r
lines(time[-(1:(burn_in+1))], traj_chaos[-(1:(burn_in+1))],
      col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.6), lwd = 1.5)
points(time[-(1:(burn_in+1))], traj_chaos[-(1:(burn_in+1))],
       col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.6), pch = 16, cex = 0.4)

# Add legend
legend("topright",
       legend = c(paste0("r = ", r_default, " (stable)"),
                  paste0("r = ", r_p4, " (period-4)"),
                  paste0("r = ", r_chaos, " (chaos)")),
       col = c(rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.8), rgb(1, 0.5, 0, 0.8), rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.8)),
       lwd = 2, cex = 0.9)
```
